location: Mars (global archive; no site selected in this manifest)

coordinate_reference_system.name: Product-specific Mars map projection
coordinate_reference_system.status: Each product label must be inspected; do not assume a common grid or projection.

license: NASA PDS data policy; verify individual product labels
limitations: No HiRISE product has been selected, downloaded or validated in this manifest.
Orthorectified image naming and processing level vary across the archive; ERRATA must be checked.
Not all products are controlled to the same cartographic reference, and DTMs may not be co-registered.
JPEG 2000 reading depends on the GDAL drivers available in the local Rasterio build.
Acquisition time, incidence, emission, phase and solar longitude must come from labels or indexes, never from filenames alone.
HiRISE coverage is not itself a multitemporal dune-change dataset.
notes: Archive-level record only. A future site-specific manifest must name individual product IDs and verify their labels before any download.
